cd /workspace && cat > tmp/dbg2.py << 'PYEOF'
import sys, random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import t4
from planner import *
import planner

seed=int(sys.argv[1])
rnd=random.Random(seed)
n,links,caps,parts,rdem0=t4.gen(rnd)
period=rnd.choice([1,3,1000])
envelope={i:min(c,10**12) for i,c in enumerate(caps) if c>0}
cpl=[period*envelope.get(i,0) for i in range(len(links))]
cap={}
for lid,(u,v) in enumerate(links):
    if cpl[lid]>0:
        cap[(u,v)]=cap.get((u,v),0)+cpl[lid]; cap[(v,u)]=cap.get((v,u),0)+cpl[lid]
k=t4.max_multiplier(n,cap,parts,rdem0)
rdem={v:rdem0[v]*k for v in parts}
total=sum(rdem.values())
print('n',n,'nl',len(links),'parts',sorted(parts),'k',k)
print('rdem',rdem)
pr=PathReserver(n,dict(cap),sorted(parts),rdem,total)
# manual loop
for it in range(50):
    S=deficient_cut(n,pr.m,sorted(parts),rdem,total)
    if S is None:
        print('done at iter',it); break
    S=[v for v in S if v in set(parts)]
    d=pr.cut_deficiency(S)
    print('iter',it,'deficient S',S,'delta',d)
    if d<=0:
        print('no deficiency?!'); break
    got=pr.push(S,d)
    print('  pushed',got)
    if got<=0:
        print('  STUCK. residual arcs out of S:', {kk:v for kk,v in pr.cap.items() if kk[0] in set(S) and v>0})
        print('  m',pr.m)
        break
else:
    print('loop limit')
PYEOF
